text:
oliver: Quick bug report — sample-app rerank batching helper produced one embedding shorter by 3 dims when packing 4 docs. repro attached below.
jenn: Which SDK / helper version? model?
oliver: go-sdk v0.6.2, sample-app master helper. Model=openembed-1536. No retries or 500s. First three embeddings 1536, last is 1533. :confused:
oliver: Raw HTTP response (trimmed):
```json
{"results":[{"id":"p1","embedding":[0.01,0.02,/* ... 1536 floats ... */]},
{"id":"p2","embedding":[0.03,0.04,/* ... 1536 floats ... */]},
{"id":"p3","embedding":[0.05,0.06,/* ... 1536 floats ... */]},
{"id":"p4","embedding":[0.07,0.08,/* ... 1533 floats (truncated) ... */]}]}
```
pat: only when using the batching helper or also per-item calls?
oliver: only batched. Single-item embedding calls always return 1536.
oliver: helper excerpt (go, simplified):
```go
func concatEmbeddings(vecs [][]float32) []float32 {
    out := make([]float32, 0, len(vecs)*1536)
    for _, v := range vecs {
        out = append(out, v...)
    }
    return out
}
// later we split by index using 1536 stride
```
pat: append should be fine — but if one slice has wrong length earlier bookkeeping when splitting could be wrong. Any off-by-one in end index computation?
jenn: also think about network-level chunking if we parse a raw bytes blob then cast to float32s. Endianness/alignment?
eng-ml: tagging @eng-ml for visibility. Two-pronged fix: (1) sample-app helper should assert len(v)==1536 before packing and pad if not; (2) add a defensive check after unpacking that logs request_id and raises an error instead of silently proceeding.
ci-bot: CI: sample-app tests failing in branch oliver/rerank-pack-check  1 failing test (embeddings_shape_assert).
oliver: mitigation in PR: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/430 — adds assert+pad+unit test that simulates truncated vector. Also added debug log with request_id.
pat: can we add an SDK-level test too? parity across languages — similar bug appeared in JS helper historically.
jenn: opened spin ticket to sync fixes across go/js/py/golang helpers and add cross-sdk fuzz tests in our eval harness.
eng-ml: please include the failing request id and repro harness path.
oliver: request_id: rq_A7kL2m3v. repro in samples/examples/rerank-trim-repro. leaving here for triage, will follow up when CI is green. :thumbsup:
